historical_record.description: The Recreation and Park Commission let the contract to demolish the buildings standing on the site of the new Eureka Valley Playground, bounded by Collingwood, 18th, Diamond and 19th Streets, for $1,000.

Ground was broken for temporary improvements at Eureka Valley Playground, 19th and Collingwood Streets, according to the official list of 1947 recreation bond playgrounds the Recreation and Park Commission entered in its minutes.

Under the 1947 recreation bond program the Recreation and Park Commission engaged A. Appleton and Harry N. Wolfard, architects, to design Eureka Valley Playground ($130,000) and its recreation building ($250,000).

The Recreation and Park Commission awarded the contract to build Eureka Valley Playground and its field house, at 19th and Collingwood Streets, to Martinelli Construction Co. at $367,500, the lowest of seven bids.
